messages:
jess (People Ops): Hi team — planning a small "Spark & Shine" recognition kit drop for folks who helped land the new integration. Goal: surprise recipients during next week's team intros. Need assembly lead, CSV QA, and budget ok.
omar (Events): I can run SF assembly on 2024-06-17 4-6pm. How many kits and what's in each?
jess (People Ops): Counts: SF 20, NY 12, Remote 28. Contents: enamel pin, mini snack, 1-line manager card (handwritten), QR microcard for shoutouts, and a tiny sticker.
lee (Logistics): Recommend splitting builds by office. I'll handle NY packing and remote label printing. Need final CSV by 6/15 EOD for postal validation.
fin (Finance): Budget code: 8-CULT-2026. If unit cost > $17 flag me. Vendor invoice for pins already cleared.
pack-bot: Inventory check: pins 70, snacks 70, blank cards 100, mailers 50.
omar (Events): Volunteers so far: omar, tasha, priya. Need one more for SF.
jess (People Ops): Can someone own address QA? I can collect raw list but need a dedupe + postal check.
lee (Logistics): I'll QA the CSV and run a dedupe + validation script. Will post cleaned CSV by 6/15 18:00.
fin (Finance): Confirmed estimated spend ~ $760 under 8-CULT-2026. No hold.
omar (Events): Assembly checklist draft:
- Pull final CSV
- Print blank manager cards + one-line prompt sheet
- Pack pin, snack, QR card, sticker
- Add "do not open until standup" sticker for surprise recipients
- Photograph 1 sample kit and upload to #culture-photos
- Label remotes for pickup

jess (People Ops): Managers will handwrite notes. We'll provide pens at the table. Can someone bring a label printer?
omar (Events): I'll bring the label printer and pens. Table reserved SF lounge 4-6pm.
lee (Logistics): Courier pickup for remote kits scheduled 6/18 09:00 PT. Please make sure weights are in the sheet.
pack-bot: Reminder set: final CSV due 2024-06-15T18:00:00Z
omar (Events): Two SF volunteer spots filled (tasha + priya). All good here.
jess (People Ops): Thanks everyone — timeline recapped: 6/15 CSV -> 6/17 SF pack -> 6/18 remote ship. I'll drop the manager prompt and packing sheet in the folder tonight. :sparkles:
